title: Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
transliterated_title: Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat (On the Splitting of the Moon and the Last Hour; variant Shaqq-i Qamar u Sāʿat)
genre: Quran commentary on Q 54:1 in seven hierarchical levels

date.ce: before 28 January 1426 (the manuscript listing prints 27 February 1426)
date.basis: MS Majlis 10196 copy date, asterisked by Melvin-Koushki as possibly transcription; CE equivalent printed as 27 Feb 1426 on p.126 and 28 Jan 1426 on p.128. Terminus ad quem only.

manuscript: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 170b-72a; 30 copies listed (earliest after it: MS 5423 ff. 355b-61b, 842/1439).
summary: Explicates Quran 54:1 on seven levels, from hadith scholars up through theologians, peripatetics, illuminationists, Sufis and lettrists to the Imams and masters of jafr; it is the text in which Ibn Turka's epistemological hierarchy is most clearly laid out.
edition_note: Persian text in Chahārdah Risāla-yi Fārsī (Tehran 1972) pp. 103-17; English translation by Melvin-Koushki in the dissertation Part 2, §T.1 (a player could read it).
